chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Muʿallā ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Awrama and Muhammad ibn ʿAbd Allah, from ʿAli ibn Hassan, from ʿAbd Allah ibn Kathir, from Abu ʿAbd Allah (عليه السلام).
Regarding His, the Exalted, saying: “What are they asking one another about? About the Great News.”
He said: “The Great News is the wilayah.”
And I asked him about His saying: “There, the wilayah belongs to Allah, the True.”
He said: “The wilayah of Amir al-Muʾminin (عليه السلام).”

key_terms.أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Amir al-Muʾminin, the title of Imam ʿAli (عليه السلام)
key_terms.اللَّهِ الْحَقِّ: Allah, the True; affirming the truth of the divine source of wilayah
key_terms.النَّبَإِ الْعَظِيمِ: the Great News, interpreted here as a reference to wilayah
key_terms.الْوَلَايَةُ: wilayah; divinely designated authority and guardianship

ai.seo_question: What does “the Great News” mean in Shia tafsir, and how is it related to the wilayah of Amir al-Muʾminin (عليه السلام)?
ai.summary: This hadith presents the Qur'anic phrase “the Great News” as referring to the wilayah. It also interprets the verse about true wilayah as referring to the wilayah of Amir al-Muʾminin ʿAli (عليه السلام), highlighting the theological centrality of wilayah in Shia tafsir.
